name: Up By The Bootstraps!
body:
Your commanding presence is so intense, you are able to help people in ways that defy logic.

Prerequisites: Leadership, Legendary Leader, Commanding Presence, Leadership score 15+

Benefit: As a standard action, you may spend a use of your Commanding Presence to give an ally, cohort, or follower within 30 feet that can see or hear you a new saving throw for any effect that would cause paralysis, blindness, daze, stun, and sleep, as well as poison and disease, so long as a new save would be possible. The target of this effect also gains a bonus to this save equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1.)
